extra.final_summary: Problems found: (1) Species label misspellings ('Adeile', 'Gentto') and island case variant ('biscoe'). (2) body_mass_g stored as text with commas. (3) Three rows with body_mass_g values (3,650,000; 3,500,000; 6,000,000) far outside the allowed 2500‑6500 g range, likely entry errors. Fixes applied: normalized species and island labels to allowed values; cast body_mass_g to numeric; excluded the three out‑of‑range rows. After cleaning, the average body mass (g) per species is: Adelie ≈ 3500, Chinstrap ≈ 3907.81, Gentoo ≈ 5248.33.
